image_description: A rear-view shot of a large white pelican standing on a rocky surface near water. The bird's head is turned away, showing the back of its neck and body. The plumage is predominantly white with some textural detail visible in the feathers. One leg is clearly visible, appearing thin and orange/brown, while the other is obscured or blends into the background/shadows. The background consists of dark rocks and shimmering water.

The background elements (water ripples and rocks) have a slightly painterly, inconsistent perspective that doesn't fully align with a realistic depth of field, contributing to a 'generated' look.
